name: proof.memoryFieldIncrementAssignment.overflow-step-dropped.1
diff:
--- a/Solidity/Calculus/Rules.lean
+++ b/Solidity/Calculus/Rules.lean
@@ -614,3 +614,3 @@
       dl{ ⟨[ v = mv.fld⊕⊕; ]⟩ ⇝
-          { memory := write(memory, mv.fld, mv.fld ± 1) ‖ v := mv.fld⊕⊕ } ⟨[ ]⟩ }
+          { memory := write(memory, mv.fld, mv.fld) ‖ v := mv.fld⊕⊕ } ⟨[ ]⟩ }
   | memoryIndexArrayIncrementAssignment :

diagnostics.message:
Solidity.Taclet.memoryFieldIncrementAssignment: Tactic `rfl` failed: The left-hand side
  Stmt.step k✝ m✝ (Stmt.assignIncDec v✝ op✝ hp✝ (OpLoc.mfield (MPath.var mv✝ hmv✝) fld✝ hfld✝) hs✝)
is not definitionally equal to the right-hand side
  Premise.update
    ((Upd.nil.snoc
          (UpdElem.memory
            (Tms.MTerm.write Tms.MTerm.memory (Tms.MAddr.field (Tms.ITerm.pv mv✝) fld✝ hfld✝)
              (Tms.MValT.val (Tms.Term.read Tms.MTerm.memory (Tms.MAddr.field (Tms.ITerm.pv mv✝) fld✝ hfld✝)))))).snoc
      (UpdElem.local v✝
        (Rhs.val
          (Tms.Term.bumped op✝ hp✝ (Tms.Term.read Tms.MTerm.memory (Tms.MAddr.field (Tms.ITerm.pv mv✝) fld✝ hfld✝))))))

C✝ : Contract
k✝ : Nat
m✝ : Modality
Γ✝ : Ctx
p✝ : PrimTy
v✝ : Idx Γ✝ (LTy.val p✝)
op✝ : IncDec
hp✝ : p✝.isNumeric = true
x✝ : Name
mv✝ : Idx Γ✝ (LTy.mem (RefTy.struct x✝))
hmv✝ : (Ty.ref (RefTy.struct x✝)).mapFree = true
fld✝ : Name
hfld✝ : C✝.fieldType x✝ fld✝ = some (Ty.prim p✝)
hs✝ : (OpLoc.mfield (MPath.var mv✝ hmv✝) fld✝ hfld✝).recvSimple = true
⊢ Stmt.step k✝ m✝ (Stmt.assignIncDec v✝ op✝ hp✝ (OpLoc.mfield (MPath.var mv✝ hmv✝) fld✝ hfld✝) hs✝) =
    Premise.update
      ((Upd.nil.snoc
            (UpdElem.memory
              (Tms.MTerm.write Tms.MTerm.memory (Tms.MAddr.field (Tms.ITerm.pv mv✝) fld✝ hfld✝)
                (Tms.MValT.val (Tms.Term.read Tms.MTerm.memory (Tms.MAddr.field (Tms.ITerm.pv mv✝) fld✝ hfld✝)))))).snoc
        (UpdElem.local v✝
          (Rhs.val
            (Tms.Term.bumped op✝ hp✝ (Tms.Term.read Tms.MTerm.memory (Tms.MAddr.field (Tms.ITerm.pv mv✝) fld✝ hfld✝))))))
